title: Measures for the Administration of Internet Information Services (Revised Draft for Comment)
title_original: 互联网信息服务管理办法（修订草案征求意见稿）
summary: Draft revision of the Measures for the Administration of Internet Information Services, a State Council regulation dating from 2000. The Cyberspace Administration of China drafted it with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Public Security. A first draft went to consultation in January 2021. A revised 94-article draft was released for a second consultation on 3 July 2026, closing on 2 August 2026. Its new section on intelligent information services would require AI service providers to disclose operating principles and training-data sources, label AI-generated content, and complete security assessment and algorithm filing for public-opinion services. It also covers AI agents.
key_obligations: Disclose AI services' basic principles, purposes, mechanisms and training-data sources
Label AI-generated content under laws and mandatory national standards
Do not force users to use intelligent information services
AI agent providers must maintain security management under national rules
